title: Food and records of a prescribed course
description: Keep food, how you feel and the details of the prescriptions side by side. Prepare the history for an appointment without adjusting the treatment yourself.

blocks.text: One existing review asks directly for records of doses and symptoms next to the food diary. That is a request to keep the information together, not to choose a prescription yourself.

quote.text: I do wonder if app developers will ever integrate something for tracking dosages for GLP1 and symptoms and such within the app, so it could all be in

blocks.text: Keep what has been prescribed apart from the observations

Allow the details of the prescribed course, the times of meals and personal notes on how you feel to be recorded. For the appointment, choose a period and look through every entry included. Record a change of prescription as information entered by the person.
Don’t widen the diary’s role unnoticed

A reminder to make an entry and a recommendation to change the dose are different functions. For the first, a clear history and a convenient selection are enough; advice about treatment does not follow from the reviews that were collected.
